title: SWC Store Manifest
description: Manifest file for an SWC state store

id.description: Unique store identifier used as the registry key and in getStore() calls

state.description: Initial state for a plain StateStore — provide either state or attributes, not both

persist.description: When true, state is persisted to localStorage under the key swc:<id> and restored on page load (unless SSR state is present)

attributes.description: Typed attribute schema for an AttributedStateStore — provide either state or attributes, not both

type.description: The data type for this attribute
